title: CRM lead material identity map
objective: Make VanillaSoft CRM lead material fields resolve the locked exact identities, with bare LDPE stored as polymer LDPE and form FILM, and with comma-separated material names imported as separate materials. Keep normalize_material unchanged so ERP worksheet lines keep today's resolver. todos.task: Add _CRM_EXACT and normalize_crm_material beside normalize_material. Match the whole collapsed casefolded description. A _SPECS hit delegates to normalize_material, including PE, Pallets, HDPE Drums, LDPE Film, and PC/ABS. An exact miss of _SPECS uses _CRM_EXACT only for that description: LDPE is LDPE plus FILM; Nylon is NYLON; Metal is METAL; E-Waste is EWASTE; HDPE- is HDPE; HDPE-HMW is HDPE_HMW; Plastic Pallets is PLASTIC_PALLETS; Gaylord Boxes is GAYLORD_BOXES; HDPE, PP, MRP, PET, ABS, PC, PS, HIPS, PVC, EPS, BOPP, TPO, TPE, PBT, and LLDPE keep those codes and an empty form. grade_evidence and structured hints still use _SPECS only, so a form hint of LDPE does not add a second identity. Two different specs conflict. Lookup is exact, never a prefix, and does not import web_lead _POLYMER_NORMALIZE. Realize through the existing _master path. No migration folder. Bump plasticos_material_profile from 19.0.5.10.8 to 19.0.5.10.9.

In _material_inputs, split ASCII commas only for phrase fields (materials, material, material (...)), after the existing newline, pipe, and semicolon split, and drop empty pieces. Leave form-hint values unsplit and leave hint promotion on normalize_material. Change only the import inside _store_normalized_materials to normalize_crm_material, which covers both the contact path and the approved-material path because both call that store. Leave the savepoint wrappers and _write_profile_classification unchanged so an empty grade or attribute set does not clear a grade already stored on the shared LDPE-plus-FILM profile. Bump plasticos_crm_sync from 19.0.1.9.4 to 19.0.1.9.5.

Add discriminating tests: normalize_material('LDPE') stays unresolved with no master lookup; normalize_crm_material('LDPE') is LDPE plus FILM; HDPE- and HDPE-HMW stay distinct; Nylon and Metal hit NYLON and METAL; a Materials value 'LDPE, HDPE Drums' stores FILM and DRUMS; 'LDPE, LDPE Film' reuses one profile; a form hint 'Roll, Film' stays one unsplit hint; graded film then bare LDPE keeps grade A and clean/dry; 'PE, LDPE' stores HDPE with an empty form and LDPE plus FILM; mystery fluff still records an error row and keeps the lead; native_document_import still calls normalize_material. Existing HDPE Drums and PC/ABS phrase tests stay green.
